delete.description: Removes the site registration and queued work while retaining the user data store.

get.description: Runs one validated analysis preset for an analytics window.
Runs several validated presets against one shared analytics pool.
Reads a bounded provider-date range from the latest successful dataset. Ranked rows are not complete Site totals.
Returns sitemap-scoped URLs whose Google-chosen canonical diverges from the declared canonical, with consolidation targets and trend.
Returns the weekly new-keyword series over the requested window with a summary trend.
Returns the position-bucketed CTR curve plus over/under-performing query outliers for the window.
Returns clicks not attributable to any tracked keyword, in total and per page, for the window.
Returns per-day desktop vs mobile CTR/position metrics with gap trends for the window.
Returns the sitemap visibility trend, invisible URLs, orphan pages, and per-sitemap counts.
Returns indexing coverage, trend, and inspection signal totals.
Returns the Bing connection state and any CNAME record required to verify the Site.

post.description: Asks Bing to verify the Site. If Bing confirms ownership, it enables the connection and queues initial sync work.

get.description: Returns dated Bing discovery and crawl observations. It does not return an indexed verdict.
Returns indexing issue groups and optional URL samples.

post.description: Runs live URL inspections against the daily per-site quota; URLs outside the site domain and over-quota URLs are reported as skipped. Exhausted quota fails with rate_limited.

get.description: Returns URL inspection state changes as bounded observation intervals. detectedAt is the first observation showing the new state, not the exact change time.
Returns the filtered URL-inspection index with pagination metadata.
Returns the pages-per-keyword-count distribution with fragile and authority page lists for the window.

post.description: Returns per-keyword daily click series for up to 20 keywords over the requested window.

get.description: Returns the daily unique-page count series for a window, with an optional previous-period total for comparison.

post.description: Force-rechecks Google Search Console access for a permission-lost site; on recovery resets sync state and queues fresh sync jobs.

get.description: Returns the per-day keyword counts bucketed by average position for the window.
Returns the daily unique-query count series for a window, with an optional previous-period total for comparison.
Returns registered sitemaps and their aggregate and per-sitemap history.

post.description: Submits, deletes, refreshes, or auto-discovers a site's sitemap; the response shape depends on the requested action.

get.description: Returns recently added and removed sitemap URLs for the requested window.
Returns a generation-pinned expiring URL for the full NDJSON sitemap projection.

post.description: Returns generation-pinned present, absent, or unknown evidence for each exact requested URL.

get.description: Returns an exact generation-pinned cursor page of sitemap membership and lastmod evidence.

patch.description: Binds or unbinds (teamId: null) a partner-owned site to a partner-owned team.
patch.summary: Bind a site to a team

get.description: Returns the single best-performing page for a keyword, or keyword for a page, over the window.

post.description: Creates a team owned by a user linked to the authenticated partner tenant.

delete.description: Deletes a team owned by the authenticated partner tenant.

patch.description: Renames a team owned by the authenticated partner tenant.

get.description: Returns the Iceberg catalog reference bound to a partner-owned team, if any.

post.description: Binds an Iceberg catalog (URI, warehouse, and optional bucket/namespace) to a partner-owned team.

get.description: Lists the members of a team owned by the authenticated partner tenant.

post.description: Adds a user to a team owned by the authenticated partner tenant, or reports it was already a member.

delete.description: Removes a member from a team owned by the authenticated partner tenant.

patch.description: Updates the role of an existing member of a team owned by the authenticated partner tenant.

post.description: Creates or updates a user owned by the authenticated partner tenant.

delete.description: Queues cascade deletion of a partner-linked user and their sites.

get.description: Lists the active API keys the authenticated partner issued for a user. Keys issued by other partners or by the user are excluded. Raw keys are never returned.

post.description: Issues a new revocable API key for a partner-linked user. The raw key appears only in this response; store or show it once. Each partner may hold at most 10 API keys per user; a create beyond the limit fails with `409 api_key_limit_reached`.

delete.description: Revokes an API key the authenticated partner issued for a user. The key stops working immediately. Revoking an already revoked key succeeds again. An unknown key, or a key issued by another partner or by the user, fails with `404 api_key_not_found`.

get.description: Lists the visible Google Search Console properties and their registration state.
Returns the authoritative lifecycle state for one visible user and their sites.

post.description: Registers one Search Console property for an authorized user.

get.description: Maps a user's public site IDs to their internal integer IDs, for partners that need the legacy numeric identifier.

post.description: Verifies Search Console ownership of a site for a user via the given method and records the verified ownership.

patch.description: Replaces the Google OAuth grant for a partner-linked user.

post.description: Mints a Search Console site-ownership verification token (meta tag or DNS record) for a not-yet-registered site.
